hero.body:
Sushi, poke and katsu made in front of you, in {city}.
A creative take on Japanese food, meant to be shared.

place.title: A dining room, not a counter
place.body:
People come to Kaido with family, with friends, at lunch and in the evening.
Banquettes, warm light, and the chef working the fish in front of you.

catering.title: For your events
catering.body: Made-up platters, delivery and service for company lunches, birthdays and receptions. Tell us how many people, we'll handle the rest.
